comments.author: @nicholasdallman4518
comments.text: Advances like this make me wonder about our place in the universe. While I don’t think we’re alone or the first intelligent life, and I do believe we live in the prime reality, what we’re doing with AI—like creating new proteins and potentially restructuring life—raises big questions. It ties into simulation theory in an interesting way: the idea that if we can simulate life, it increases the likelihood that we ourselves are in a simulation. But at the same time, being able to create and manipulate life in our own reality feels like discovering the "coding" of our universe. It’s one thing to be the "god" of a simulation, but to essentially unlock the tools to create life at will within your own reality suggests a deeper understanding of its fundamental mechanics. It’s a wild rabbit hole to explore. Even if that understanding comes from a tool we created we don't fully understand. In the end, if our creation, creates, it still only happened because we created.
